# 🧩 Cybercore kit (generated)

Served live to every Cybercore Pages site.

**Do not edit these files here** except `contact.js`. They are generated from
[cybercoretech/cybercore](https://github.com/cybercoretech/cybercore) and
arrive as PRs from the *Sync from cybercore* workflow:

| File | Source in cybercore |
| --- | --- |
| `chooser.js`, `chooser.css` | `web/chooser.js`, `web/chooser.css` |
| `v1/cybercore.js`, `v1/effects.css` | `web/cybercore.js`, `web/effects.css` |
| `v1/tokens.css`, `v1/components.css` | `css/cybertokens.css`, `css/cybercomponents.css` |
| `v1/webkit.json` | `schema/webkit.json` |

See [docs/distribution.md](https://github.com/cybercoretech/cybercore/blob/main/docs/distribution.md).
